resolutions.phrase: The soak should be two weeks, not one: the batch jobs only run weekly.
resolutions.why: Commentary directly challenges the settled one-week soak duration and the architectural premise that weekly batch reconciliation jobs were retired.

referents.why: Rejects the revised one-week minimum soak duration in favor of reverting to two weeks.
Asserts batch jobs run weekly, directly contradicting the prior finding that nothing on the new platform runs on a weekly cycle.
Contradicts the proposed one-week soak timeline based on Dockside exception rate flattening by day four.
Contradicts the formal ratification setting the inter-site soak to one week.
